freshInfo.title: For cooking, not for ripening
freshInfo.text: We cut the bananas while green so they hold up when cooked and don't fall apart in the pot. Stored in a cool, dry place, they keep for [4 to 7] days [TO BE CONFIRMED with the supplier].
freshInfo.tip: Don't refrigerate them if you don't want the peel to darken.

origin.title: From {municipio} to {ciudad}
origin.text: We work with {productor} in {municipio}, {departamento}. We receive the bananas at our collection center in {ciudad} and distribute them from there. Every batch carries its cutting date.
origin.imageAlt: Hands sorting green bananas at the collection center.

recipes.title: What can you cook with green banana?

benefits.title: What it provides
benefits.text: Green banana is a source of resistant starch, a type of fiber. It is a traditional cooking food and does not replace advice from a health professional.

business.title: Do you run a shop, hotel or retail outlet?

guarantee.title: Is there a problem with your order?
guarantee.text: You have 24 hours from delivery to call us or email the contact address with a photo of the product and the receipt. We replace it in the next delivery or refund your money [TO BE CONFIRMED policy, RP-04].
guarantee.legalNote: As a perishable product, the right of withdrawal does not apply. This guarantee is in addition to your rights as a consumer.
